name: coxph
description: Federated algorithm for a Cox proportional hazards model

functions.name: central
functions.description: Fit a federated Cox proportional hazards model using Newton-Raphson iteration on the partial likelihood.

ui_visualizations.name: Model coefficients
ui_visualizations.description: Coefficient table for the fitted Cox model, including hazard ratios, standard errors, confidence intervals, Z- and p-values.

arguments.name: time_col
arguments.description: The column name of the survival/follow-up time variable.

arguments.name: outcome_col
arguments.description: The column name of the event indicator (1 = event occurred, 0 = censored).

arguments.name: expl_vars
arguments.description: The column names of the covariates to include in the Cox model.

arguments.name: organization_ids
arguments.description: The organizations to include in the computation. If not provided, all organizations in the collaboration are included.

databases.name: Database
databases.description: Database to use for the Cox model fit
